Evelyn Park: Quick question — we hired a contractor (1099) starting remote Mon. Hes CA-based but will come onsite Wed for a fast intro and badge pickup. Do we need an I-9 for 1099s? Also needs laptop day-1, any courier rules?
Diego Ramos: He's a true 1099 (vendor-approved). No benefits. My understanding: I-9s are for employees (W-2). For contractors we need W9 + contract signed + COI if vendor requires. Can confirm w/ you Alyssa.
Alyssa - People Ops: Correct: independent contractors typically do NOT complete I-9. We need signed SOW, W-9, invoice remit, and vendor onboarding checklist. If hes ever moved to employee later we would do I-9 then.
Alyssa - People Ops: Logistics notes:
- Laptop: we can either courier to home or hold at Satellite Office (SoMa) for pickup.
- Badge: visitor badge OK for Wed; full access requires sponsor + photo ID.
- Tax: request completed W-9 before first invoice.
Diego Ramos: Sponsor will be me. Can we reserve a 30-min badge slot Wed 10:30? Hell bring passport & CA license.
IT Shipments: We can hold the machine at SoMa desk. Default hold window is 5 business days. If you want courier instead, add "SIGNATURE_REQUIRED" flag.
Evelyn Park: He prefers pickup (no home address). Can we also ensure VPN enablement for contractors (limited access)?
Alyssa - People Ops: VPN for vendors: need signed vendor access form + manager approval ticket. Diego, can you confirm systems he needs?
Diego Ramos: Minimal access: email, Slack, repo read-only, staging env. I approve vendor access in ticketing.
Alyssa - People Ops: Great. Next steps Ill handle:
1) Send W-9 + onboarding packet email to contractor.
2) Create IT ticket for laptop hold at SoMa and VPN access (vendor-scoped).
3) Schedule visitor badge w/ security Wed 10:30 (sponsor: Diego).
4) Mark "no I-9 required" in HRIS for this contractor role.
people-ops-bot: Task created: ONBOARD-8739. Security badge slot reserved Wed 10:30. IT hold placed (SoMa).

Evelyn Park: One gotcha — the vendor onboarding team asked for proof of right-to-work in their vendor portal. Alyssa, can we attach a scan of passport/driver's license to the vendor portal without creating I-9? Privacy ok?
Alyssa - People Ops: Yes we can upload redacted ID for vendor verification only, store in vendor portal with limited access. I'll confirm retention policy.
Diego Ramos: Perfect. Also, flag for payroll: mark as 1099 so benefits and tax withholding not applied.
Alyssa - People Ops: Done. Email to contractor sent with W-9 + pickup instructions. I'll follow up if W-9 not returned by EOD Fri and escalate to procurement.
Evelyn Park: Thanks team :pray:
